**1.029: late words stay on the clipboard.**

- **Late words:** when Enter goes in before the last words, Ctrl+V now pastes just the words that were missed. With "whole take on the clipboard" on, the whole take used to replace them a moment later.
- **Overlay:** a new setting, *Only while the last words come in*, shows a small spinner from Stop until the last words are in, so you can see when Enter would still be too early. It is the default for new installs; existing settings are kept.
- Windows and the AppImage stay on 1.026.
- Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
